title: Searching for a picture of Chris Kelly
summary: Chris Kelly avoided photographs; his wife Edna and Jack say they have none or one.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: Yeah, I guess they never did, probably never were, eh? Mm-hmm. Did you ever see a picture of Chris Kelly? No, I never had. You never did find one?

Well, Chris was a fellow, I tell you, he didn't never care about taking those pictures. You know what I mean? Because, I mean, them guys, I don't know, there's something funny about them. A whole lot of people don't like to take pictures of the song, might break the camera and so forth, you know what I mean? It's something.
Yeah, they don't have time on them, eh? No.
I met his wife the other day, Edna. Yeah. And I asked about, did she ever get a picture of him? She said no. She said, Chris never did care about taking those pictures. Yeah.
I asked her that, too. She said she did see one once, but she's never been able to find one.
Well, Jack told me he had one, and I've been trying to get Jack, but I'll be Jack this, tell her I, you know, don't be. Yeah. Jack said he had one, he had his picture.
He said he looks a whole lot like one.
Does he look like one? Yeah, he looks like Jack. Does he have the same building, you know, like he's like...
Yeah. Like a red ball. That's right.
